name: Cold Email Agency Services
sell:
We sell a fully done for you cold email service which is enhanced by the power of three core AI systems:
-Our own lead generation software and database, so our customers can gain access to leads their competitors don't
-A speed to lead reply agent which takes interested leads and books them into our clients calendar automatically, to ensure no lead slips through the cracks
-A large scale data analysis system which allows us to make data backed decisions to enhance results
icpText: We are in the beginning phases of our company right now so we are open to different types of industries, but we are mainly targeting digital marketing agencies, AI automation agencies and AI companies which have some sort of unique mechanism to help companies make more money
pains: Wasted time and money spent running outbound yourself
Exclusive AI systems which competitors don't have access to
disqualifiers: Cold email or GTM agencies selling their services
They are from India, Pakistan or any other third world country which doesn't have a strong currency
qualifiers: They are based in the US or EU
They mention that their company has something to with marketing, AI or automation services
They mention they're looking for SDRs or BDRs (adjacent to our services)
